notes: Reviewed; returned unchanged apart from note wording. Partition checked: s001–s012 and t001–t014 each used exactly once, every head a member of its array.
s001/s003 split follows rule 32 (οἱ κατοικοῦντες → they that dwell), not rule 90, because the ASV writes two English words for the article-plus-participle pair.
s012's copula placement is the only genuinely contested unit; kept medium with the competing rule 53 reading named, and rule 92's EPH.6.9 precedent added as the support for the accepted reading.
εἰς → in kept on the preposition rather than absorbed into establisheth (rule 36).
καί is expressed, so and is aligned to s009 in the ordinary way; rule 88's supplied-juncture question does not arise, and χρίσας takes no second relativizer because the ASV writes none.
